sources.title: ornith-ai/Ornith-1.5-397B-FP8 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This model card documents Ornith-1.5-397B, the flagship member of the Ornith-1.5 family — a 397B mixture-of-experts model. It scores 86.1 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and 56.0 on DeepSWE, performing on par with Claude Opus 4.8 (85.0 and 59.0) while outperforming leading open-source models of similar scale, including GLM-5.2 and DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731.

sources.title: Ornith-1.5: From Self-Scaffolding to Self-Improvement
sources.snippet: Ornith-1.5 extends the self-scaffolding framework introduced in Ornith-1.0 into a more complete self-improvement loop: the model proposes new tasks, generates task-specific scaffolds, and produces solution rollouts for reinforcement learning, continuously creating new learning experiences from which it can improve.
